chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah the Exalted support him—informed me of, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā and al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Sinān, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about a man who urinates in flowing water. He said: “There is no objection to it if the water is flowing.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no objection to it; it is not problematic

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on urinating in flowing water according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning urinating in flowing water. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no objection if the water is flowing, indicating a distinction in fiqh between flowing and still water in matters of ritual purity and impurity.
